evidence.event: Garmin Marathon in the Land of Oz
evidence.note: The medal confirms a 2017 event association, but repeated official-result searches found no Alex/Alexander Ford participant match, the Strava export contains no half-marathon-scale activity around the event, and no convincing evidence of a 2017 virtual option was recovered. Do not publish a 2017 Garmin finish unless stronger evidence appears.

The medal and a 7.24 km Strava run strongly suggest a match. Runnin' of the Green 7K is the likely related Denver/HAL Sports event, but the medal's Mile High Leprechaun naming has not yet been reconciled to a surviving official event page, so this remains research evidence rather than a public record.
User explicitly confirms that the Snow Mountain Ranch 1st Place Age Class award belongs to the Sunday 25K Classic leg of the Ranch Hand weekend.

Online Race Results lists the COLDERBolder 5K on December 2, 2023, matching the Strava recording. A current BOLDERBoulder historical archive page labels the 2023 COLDERBolder as December 9. Preserve December 2 in the race record while retaining this discrepancy for source reconciliation.
Medal identity, official Maryland Timing event calendar, and the exact-date 4.92 km Strava activity named Marriott Baltimore Waterfront resolve this as the 2019 Gobble Cobble 5K.
Original alexlford.com race inventory, medal evidence, the official 2025 marathon weekend, and the exact-date 42.66 km Strava activity identify the race. Official chip time remains pending recovery.
